question_text: A 68-year-old man is brought to the emergency department by ambulance from a homeless shelter. The report from the shelter describes the man as a loner expressing symptoms of depression. He has been living at the shelter for approximately 10 months and has no family or friends and few visitors. He spends most of his evenings drinking alcohol and being by himself. Which of the following statements is most accurate regarding this patient?
